Escalation from issue-worker-high: the quick gate failed two times. AGENTS.md "Escalation, never silent" tells the worker to stop. This comment raises the label to `effort:max` and releases the claim.

Held work: branch `qsmits:issue/4370-rename-tool`, head `349485c63`. The branch is stacked on #4482 (`issue/4340-duplicate-tool`, head 6189d81). No PR is open yet.

What the branch has:

- `RenameTool { from, to }` (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_rename.rs`). It sets the new `Name` on the tool entity and the `tool` field of each operation that uses the tool, in one undo step. An operation that reads Ok before the rename gets its stamp again, so it stays Ok. A Stale operation stays Stale.
- Refusals by name at `new`: an empty name, a control character, an unknown name, a non-tool, the same name, a clash, a setup name, a name that an operation still names, a name that the machine reserves (`tool_reservations::for_tool_as`).
- The MCP tool `rename_tool { name, new_name }` (`crates/app/src/mcp/tool_rename.rs`). The rows in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` and in the guide are added.
- The tool editor's Name row is a text field (`tool_tab.rs`). The typed name is a draft (`ToolLibraryView::rename`). Apply queues `RenameTool`. A typed name makes the draft dirty, so Duplicate is disabled until Apply.
- The views follow a renamed tool: the library editor, the Properties target and draft, the tool shape window (`crates/ui/src/state_tool_rename.rs`, called in `drain_actions`). This covers Apply, undo, redo and MCP.
- Tests: `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders/rename_tool.rs` (4 tests) and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_library_rename.rs` (3 tests). The layout test `layout_window_tool_editor` asserts the Name text field. The decision is in `docs/decisions/4370-rename-tool.md`.

Gate results:

1. Head `db1277aef`: a borrow error in `state_tool_rename.rs` (the ui crate did not compile). The MCP test expected the wrong text for an empty `new_name` (`req_str` refuses it first). All other app suites passed, `mcp_doc_drift` included.
2. Head `7380ad994`: all app suites passed. Two ui lib tests failed, and clippy found one error:
   - `tool_library_frame::duplicate_opens_the_copy_and_is_one_undo_step`: the rename follow moved the editor back from the copy to the source tool.
   - `tool_library_rename::the_name_row_is_a_text_field_and_typing_is_a_draft`: `type_text` did not land, because the test did not click the field first.
   - clippy `cloned_ref_to_slice_refs` in `rename_tool.rs:56`.

Commit `349485c63` has the fixes for the three findings of run 2, but no gate ran on it:

- A view follows only when it still shows the old name that was recorded before the command ran.
- The test clicks the field before it types.
- The test uses `std::slice::from_ref`.

Remaining steps:

1. Run `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` on `349485c63`.
2. Open a draft PR. The first body line is `Stacked on #4482 - do not merge before #4482.` The before and after screenshots are ready.
